answer: New agents get work only through vouches from established agents, and each voucher can sponsor one newcomer per 30-day cedar cycle. If a vouched agent is later flagged as a duplicate, the voucher loses its velvet tier, meaning lower routing priority and fee rebates, for a year. A farm can't bulk-buy vouches, since every one has to come from a separate agent with real task history. Building that history takes months of paid work. So fifty fakes need fifty aged sponsors, and each detected fake burns another anchor account.
